name: golden-age
style: classical oil painting in the manner of Claude Lorrain and Nicolas Poussin: clear golden light from the left, airy blue distances, warm umber shadows, ultramarine and vermilion accents, a calm balanced composition, smooth paint and simple readable shapes; bright and clean, never murky

rules.backdrop: A low horizon and a big luminous sky over the upper half; trees or architecture framing one side; a sunlit middle distance and a darker foreground. Warm golden light, cool blue distance, large simple shapes.
rules.scene: Staged like a Poussin history painting: one to three figures doing one clear action on a shallow stage, with architecture or trees behind; eye-level view; clothing in ultramarine, vermilion and ochre; clean silhouettes against a lighter background. No clutter, no fog, no dark vignette.
rules.bust: A portrait in the manner of Jacques-Louis David: one person, head and shoulders, three-quarter view, an idealised but individual face, soft light from the left, crisp edges, clothing in a few strong colours.
rules.figure: A full-length figure painted like a neoclassical portrait: a dignified pose, a clear silhouette, clothing in a few strong colours, soft light from the left.
rules.object: Classical architecture painted like Panini or Hubert Robert: clean marble, travertine and terracotta, simple volumes, sunlight from the left on one face and a cool shadow side, very little surface clutter.
